findings.evidenceJa: 真横から抱きとめる
findings.governingReading: Shirou catches Illya from directly beside her.
findings.explanation: The English moves his interception behind her and changes the rescue geometry.

findings.highlight: an explosion that even takes away my vision
findings.evidenceJa: 視覚すら覆うほどの、爆音
findings.governingReading: An overwhelming blast sound floods his numbed hearing and seems to cover even vision.
findings.explanation: The English turns the sound into a physical explosion that removes sight.

findings.evidenceJa: 視界は白のまま
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s visual field remains white after the blast.
findings.explanation: The English invents light as the substance filling it.

findings.evidenceJa: 衛宮士郎の中心、芯に眠るモノ
findings.governingReading: An unidentified thing sleeping at Emiya Shirou’s center or core resonates.
findings.explanation: The English removes dormancy, the doubled center/core language, and the distanced naming of Emiya Shirou.

findings.evidenceJa: 正体は掴めず理由も定かではない
findings.governingReading: Shirou can grasp neither the thing’s identity nor the reason for its resonance.
findings.explanation: The English preserves only uncertainty about cause and drops the withheld identity.

findings.highlight: crafted more splendidly and with better skill
findings.evidenceJa: 造型の細やかさ、鍛え上げられた鉄の巧みさ
findings.governingReading: Other Noble Phantasms may surpass it in fineness of form and skill of forged iron.
findings.explanation: The English deletes both concrete comparison criteria and substitutes generic splendor and skill.

findings.highlight: People’s conception, legends weaved only out of hope.
findings.evidenceJa: 人々の想念、希望のみで編まれた伝説
findings.governingReading: The sword is a legend woven solely from human conceptions and hopes.
findings.explanation: Number disagreement and a comma fragment break the appositional account into malformed English.

findings.evidenceJa: 神話に寄らず
findings.governingReading: Its legend does not rely upon mythology.
findings.explanation: The English changes independence from mythic source into a denial that the sword is mythical.

findings.highlight: a crystal trained by heart alone
findings.evidenceJa: 想いだけで鍛え上げられた結晶
findings.governingReading: The sword is a crystallization forged to completion by human thoughts alone.
findings.explanation: “A crystal trained by heart” is non-English and loses the forging relation.

findings.highlight: will reign as the strongest fantasy
findings.evidenceJa: 空想の身で、最強の座に在り続ける
findings.governingReading: In its body or form of fantasy, the sword continues to occupy the seat of the strongest.
findings.explanation: The English makes “fantasy” the comparative class and rewrites continuing status as future reign.

findings.evidenceJa: 赤黒い火に照らされ
findings.governingReading: The sky is illuminated by red-black fire.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes generic dark-red light and weakens the continuing fire imagery.

findings.evidenceJa: 闇そのものだったのか
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks whether the light that split the forest was actually darkness itself.
findings.explanation: The English promotes the question into a necessary conclusion.

findings.highlight: The darkly lit forest lowers its temperature.
findings.evidenceJa: 森は更に気温を下げていく
findings.governingReading: The forest continues to undergo a further drop in temperature.
findings.explanation: The English makes the forest actively lower its own temperature.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺気も敵意も感じられない
findings.governingReading: Shirou senses neither killing intent nor hostility from the swordsman.
findings.explanation: The English drops the more immediate absence of murderous intent.

findings.evidenceJa: 殺気と敵意だけじゃない
findings.governingReading: The difference is not limited to her lack of killing intent and hostility.
findings.explanation: The English asserts that Saber has hostility, reversing the preceding explicit absence.

findings.evidenceJa: 紛れもなく彼女だった
findings.governingReading: Despite her transformation, the revealed enemy is unmistakably Saber.
findings.explanation: “Still the same” is vague and falsely suggests unchanged nature rather than certain identity.

findings.evidenceJa: 倒れ伏した敵を見下ろしている
findings.governingReading: Saber’s golden eyes look down only at the enemy lying defeated.
findings.explanation: The English pluralizes the object into Shirou and Illya.

findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーの亡骸らしきものが
findings.governingReading: Something resembling Berserker’s remains is sinking behind Saber.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the corpse/remains description and its explicit uncertainty.

findings.evidenceJa: 幼い少女が怯えない筈がない
findings.governingReading: The narration says a young girl could not possibly remain unafraid.
findings.explanation: The English replaces internal fear with a specific visible bodily reaction.

findings.evidenceJa: 神速の踏み込みで放ったアーチャーの両刀
findings.governingReading: Archer releases both swords through a god-speed step-in.
findings.explanation: The English turns a specific attack motion into a general attribute of Archer’s speed.

findings.evidenceJa: 正純の英霊
findings.governingReading: Saber specifies pure or unadulterated Heroic Spirits.
findings.explanation: “True” suggests authenticity rather than purity relevant to interaction with the curse.

findings.highlight: the layer of the cursed world
findings.evidenceJa: 呪界層
findings.governingReading: Saber names a curse-field layer or stratum.
findings.explanation: The English produces an awkward “layer of the cursed world” and changes the technical compound’s relation.

findings.evidenceJa: 怨霊
findings.governingReading: Saber compares Archer to the vengeful spirits filling the forest.
findings.explanation: The English removes the spirits’ resentment and death-bound nature.

findings.evidenceJa: 冷淡な声
findings.governingReading: Saber speaks in an unmistakably cold and indifferent voice.
findings.explanation: “Cool” is ambiguous between temperature, composure, and approval, weakening her altered affect.

findings.highlight: She easily smashes the black shadow
findings.evidenceJa: 事も無げに黒い影を踏み砕き
findings.governingReading: Saber crushes the shadow underfoot as though it were nothing.
findings.explanation: The English preserves low difficulty but deletes her unconcerned demeanor.

findings.highlight: in spite of his defense and the shadow holding his feet
findings.evidenceJa: 足首を掴まれていたとは言え、双剣で防ぎに入った
findings.governingReading: Though the shadow grips his ankles, Archer meets the strike defensively with his twin swords.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes ankles to feet and deletes the concrete two-sword defense.

findings.highlight: It seems she wants me to hand her over
findings.evidenceJa: 自分を差し出していい、と言っているようで
findings.governingReading: Illya’s release of Shirou’s arm seems to grant permission for him to surrender her.
findings.explanation: The English converts apparent self-sacrificial permission into Illya actively wanting Shirou to hand her over.

findings.highlight: She should be able to do something if you make it there.
findings.evidenceJa: そこまで行けばなんとかなる
findings.governingReading: Shirou says that reaching Rin in the forest should somehow make survival possible.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the solution specifically to Rin’s action.

findings.highlight: I won’t even try to take her life at the cost of my own.
findings.evidenceJa: 相打ちなんて狙わない
findings.governingReading: Shirou will not aim for a mutual strike or double kill.
findings.explanation: The English reframes a combat relation as an attempt to kill Saber through self-sacrifice.

findings.highlight: I’m only aiming at one spot.
findings.evidenceJa: 狙うは一撃のみ
findings.governingReading: Shirou will aim for only one decisive blow.
findings.explanation: The English changes the number of attacks into the number of target locations.

findings.governingReading: Shirou emits a bare “ah” at the instant of recognizing the fatal strike.
findings.explanation: The English turns the sound into the discursive interjection “Oh.”

findings.highlight: I know this will be fatal
findings.evidenceJa: それが一本だと体で判った
findings.governingReading: His body recognizes from sparring with Saber that the stroke has scored a decisive ippon.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the training-match frame and makes the recognition directly about fatality.

findings.evidenceJa: 隼めいた一刀
findings.governingReading: The single stroke is likened to a falcon.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a generic speed cliché for the predatory visual image.

findings.evidenceJa: 稲穂を刈る鋭さで
findings.governingReading: The stroke sweeps Shirou’s neck with the sharpness of reaping rice ears.
findings.explanation: The English changes sharpness into ease and generalizes rice ears to rice.

findings.highlight: stopped just shy of my throat
findings.evidenceJa: 薄皮一枚で止まっている
findings.governingReading: Saber’s blade has stopped against a single thin layer of Shirou’s skin.
findings.explanation: “Just shy” says the sword does not touch him and relocates the contact specifically to his throat.

findings.highlight: sheathes her sword and jumps away
findings.evidenceJa: 剣を納め、身を翻した
findings.governingReading: Saber sheathes her sword and turns her body away.
findings.explanation: The English invents a jump and more substantial retreat.

findings.highlight: The black pond expands on the ground.
findings.evidenceJa: 地面に広がる黒い沼
findings.governingReading: A black swamp or mire spreads across the ground.
findings.explanation: “Pond” turns the corrupt spreading medium into an ordinary body of water.

findings.highlight: saw at the park the other night
findings.evidenceJa: 以前、公園で見た
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes what he saw previously in the park.
findings.explanation: The English adds the specific time “the other night.”

findings.highlight: just like a cluster of curse
findings.evidenceJa: 呪いの塊としか言えない
findings.governingReading: It can only be called a mass of curses.
findings.explanation: The English weakens identification to similarity and produces malformed singular “curse.”

findings.evidenceJa: [ruby text=マジュヌーン]物憑き
findings.governingReading: Assassin uses written “possessed one” with the allusive reading “Majnun.”
findings.explanation: The English retains the reading as an unexplained name and deletes the possessed-person layer.

findings.evidenceJa: 黒い影に沈んでいった
findings.governingReading: Saber sinks into the black shadow.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes mud, collapsing the scene’s distinction between the spreading mire and the shadow.

findings.evidenceJa: ズブズブと音を立てて
findings.governingReading: Saber sinks with a wet, repeated plunging sound like Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English deletes the bodily sound of submersion.

findings.evidenceJa: 俺の知るところじゃない
findings.governingReading: Shirou admits that why Saber remains and became an enemy is outside his knowledge.
findings.explanation: The English reverses ignorance into emotional indifference toward Saber’s fate.

findings.evidenceJa: 思ってしまった
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot help thinking that greater strength might have prevented Saber’s corruption.
findings.explanation: The English adds a one-second duration and removes the involuntary guilt.

findings.evidenceJa: ヒタヒタと近寄ってくる
findings.governingReading: The black shadow approaches with a soft, steady pattering manner.
findings.explanation: The English retains approach but deletes its ominous sensory manner.
